method: Each decision rests on Edge of the World takes under the product controller in both source roles, the partner checked from its own presentation state on the observer and the source's native player states polled: mission-coverage-v1328q (hard landing, candidate 1214cq), mission-coverage-v1328h and 1328o (swimming, water exit, candidates 1214cp/cq) and window-traversal-v1235i (the climbable window, 1214cq). Each mission take ends with the lab checkpoint restore and the protected-file check; reviewed observer videos are listed per item.

items.scope: A damaging ~12 m fall onto the dock in both roles (health held): the source enters the native CatFall with the strong landing scene (cat_fall_strong, 1066 ms, bound to the body and both arms), the partner presents it as the hard landing (traversal variant 6, 15 samples) and walks on. The light landing after 5-6 m falls was accepted earlier (audit 1283).

visual.verdict: Corvo drops onto the dock and lands in a deep crouch with one hand on the planks, holds it a moment, rises and walks on.
Emily lands from the fall in the same braced crouch, pushes up and walks away along the dock.

items.scope: Crossing the climbable Edge of the World window in both roles: the native mantle through the window (crossed from one side to the other) is presented on the partner (traversal weight 1, presentation weight 1 throughout).

visual.verdict: Emily steps up to the window, plants her hands on the sill, swings through the opening and drops out of sight on the far side.

items.scope: Native swimming in both roles: forward, lateral and backward strokes, treading, sinking and rising are presented (about 184 samples per role, strokes 82-98 with 37-39 lateral, sink and rise episodes).

visual.verdict: From behind, Emily strokes away through the murky water, slips under and surfaces again, then treads water with her arms out.

items.scope: Swimming to the dock and climbing out in both roles: the partner swims, then presents the native ledge exit (traversal variants 1, 4) and stands on land; dives and surfacing are presented within swimming (sink and rise).

visual.verdict: Corvo swims up to the dock edge, pulls himself up onto it in one movement, stands and steps forward.
